title: LESS is MORE on your resume ✍️
description:
Most of the stuff on your resume likely doesn't relate to the role you're applying for and you really should remove those items. You might have been told you should put everything you’ve ever done on your resume but you really only want to put the items that are RELEVANT to the job you’re applying to.
